label: Deposit size spread (coefficient of variation)
note: Population standard deviation of dots[].area_ratio divided by its mean, over the 15 detected deposits in cv_output.json. vision/main.py reports the same value (0.4859). Above the 0.15 threshold web/packs/nsw/index.ts uses.

label: Mean deposit circularity
note: Mean of dots[].circularity. Above the 0.80 threshold for tailing or irregular shape.

label: Oversized deposits
note: Dots tagged oversized (area above 1.40x the recipe's nominal area).

label: Undersized deposits
note: Dots tagged undersized (area below 0.70x the recipe's nominal area).

label: Small dots with a following dot
note: Dots tagged missing or undersized that are not the last dot in dispense order. Dispense order is the profile index order, which holds for every vision/synth layout; a real recipe must supply it.

label: Small dots followed by an oversized dot
note: Of the small dots above, how many have an oversized dot next in dispense order (dot 9 -> 10). The documented carryover signature (matc82 sec 3.5).

label: Chance that a given dot is oversized
note: Oversized dots among dispense positions 2..15 (the positions that can follow another dot): 3 of 14.

label: Probability of this many small-then-big pairs by chance
note: Binomial probability of at least small_then_big_count successes in small_dot_count tries at oversized_share. 0.619 means the observed pairing is what random placement produces most of the time.
